Now welcoming patients from Gentle Dental Boston.
Several parking lots located around Newbury Street, along with parking garage behind building. Street parking is available, but limited.

Located in an iconic 4 floor Back Bay brownstone, Newbury Dental has been a fixture on Newbury Street for over 40 years. Our office is led by Dental Director, Dr. Jonathan Millen, who was named “Top Dentist” by Boston Magazine in 2017 and 2018. In 2019 the practice received a top to bottom interior renovation and refurbishment of the iconic Newbury Dental “tooth sign” which sits perched high above busy Newbury Street.
Newbury Dental now welcomes patients from Gentle Dental Boston.

Our dentists and dental specialists provide a full range of dental services in a comfortable welcoming setting. Preventive care such as digital x-rays and cleanings and more advanced services like braces and root canals are available in-house with no need for a referral.

Our Newbury Dental Associates dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services. By staying on top of the latest advances in dental care with continuing education and training patients can feel confident in the high quality care they receive. Building long-standing, trusting relationships with patients is a key part of overall care.
Come in for a consultation today!
Schedule a consultation with the dentist and discover how you can get the smile you love. We are experts in cosmetic and restorative dentistry including dental implants.

Our goal is to make quality dental care affordable. Gentle Dental welcomes most dental insurance plans. Our special offers and extended payment options make dental care affordable for most budgets. We also accept Care Credit and Essential Dental discount dental plan. During your visit, our trained staff can assist you in meeting your financial obligations.
We are in-network providers with most major dental insurance companies. Call us to confirm coverage.
Credit card and personal checks accepted.

Care Credit is a third-party healthcare credit card that helps finance healthcare related costs. Care Credit extends special financing options that you can’t get when using your Visa or MasterCard. Whether you use your healthcare credit card to cover your deductible, or to pay for treatments and procedures not covered by insurance, CareCredit helps make them possible today.

Gentle Dental accepts Essential Dental Plan which allows members to receive the dental care they need at the savings they can afford. Get instant access to significant savings on all dental services plus free exams and x-rays. Choose individual, two-individual, or family coverage and enjoy peace of mind knowing you can maintain your oral health. The Essential Dental Plan is not insurance.

Gentle Dental partners with Sunbit to pay for treatment over time. Sunbit allows patients to split their treatment cost into monthly payments for up to 72 months. Over 85% of patients who apply are approved.

Newbury Dental Associates is a friendly dentist office in Arlington that provides comprehensive dental care to its patients. Your search for an affordable dentist office near home ends here. At Newbury Dental Associates, patients receive award-winning dental care from the best dentists in the neighborhood. With the latest in dental technology including digital low radiation x-rays, 3D scanning and intraoral cameras, Newbury Dental Associates is the best dentist in Newbury. Come visit our dentist office in Newbury today!

Newbury Dental Associates sees emergency dental cases the same day as it can be acutely painful and discomforting for the patient. Newbury Dental Associates provides emergency dental services and tends to dental emergencies such as chipped, cracked or missing teeth, tooth or Gum Abscess, toothache, mouth pain, bitten/cut tongue or cheek, broken braces wires or brackets, jaw pain and other such dental emergencies cases. Newbury Dental Associates provides emergency care that can help alleviate your pain and discomfort and help prevent permanent damage or bone loss. Just call to schedule a dental emergency appointment today.
